_meta.purpose: Per-error policy for the LLM cleanup pass over js2jac harvest output. Keyed by converter error code. Derived from shadcn_harvest3.jsonl (74 converted repos).

actions.strip: delete the offending construct; component logic continues without it
actions.rewrite: transform in place into a Jac-legal form that preserves behavior
actions.reject: do not emit this file into the dataset at all

fidelity.preserving: output still does what the React did
fidelity.lossy: strip/rewrite drops real behavior -> keep ONLY for the surface-syntax dataset; REJECT for the faithful/round-trip dataset

_meta.dataset_switch: faithful_mode=true promotes every fidelity=lossy entry from its action to 'reject'

E7205.family: Unsupported top-level form (const-init wall). Dispatch on the init= tag.

tagged:styled | call:makeStyles | call:c.rule: CSS-in-JS. Unmodelable ceiling. Drop the whole file in faithful mode; in syntax mode strip the styled() call and inline a plain className string.

call:Inter | call:localFont | call:Poppi.rule: Next.js font loader. Delete the const; replace `${font.className}` usages with an empty or literal className string.

ObjectExpression | ArrayExpression.rule: Plain exported data. Convert to a `glob` with a typed literal, or inline at each use-site. This is the recoverable/sound-reuse bucket.

call:z | call:cva.rule: zod schema / class-variance-authority. If the value is only used for a type, drop it and inline the object type. If used as data (cva variants), lift to a plain object literal.

call:createTRPCReact | call:createContex.rule: Framework/runtime singleton wiring. Strip the const and any call sites; it is not component logic.

ExpressionStatement | ExportAllDeclarati.rule: Side-effect line or barrel re-export. Delete it.

E7202.msg: Only intrinsic JSX tags supported in V1
E7202.rule: Custom/imported component used as a JSX tag. Semantic gap in V1; reject the file rather than strip the render.

E7208.rule: Non-core hook (useScroll etc). Strip the hook call and any state it feeds. Lossy -> reject in faithful mode.

E7221.msg: Generic props type Readonly<...> not supported
E7221.rule: Unwrap Readonly<T>; inline the object type as the props annotation.

E7201.rule: Map unsupported type ref to `any`/`str`, or drop the annotation if unused for inference.

E7405.rule: Remove the import. If the imported data is rendered, inline a small literal; else drop the dependent branch.

E7406.rule: Dedupe or rename the second export.

E7215.rule: Preserve as a plain call / interop per converter guidance.

E7214.msg: Unsupported statement in useEffect body (only calls allowed)
E7214.rule: Extract non-call statements into a helper called from the effect, or lift them out of the effect.

E7207.rule: Converter self-check failed; output is untrustworthy. Reject.

E7218.msg: React.ElementRef ref type does not accept type args
E7218.rule: Drop the type arguments on ElementRef.

E7217.rule: Remove the index/second parameter; if index is used for keys, drop the key attr.

E7232.rule: Replace destructured param with a single param + destructure inside the body.

E7210.msg: useState non-empty composite initializer not supported
E7210.rule: Split composite initial state into separate useState fields, or move init into an effect.

E7233.msg: Helper needs a return type annotation
E7233.rule: Add the inferred return type annotation to the helper.

E7410.msg: Cross-file props type alias not supported
E7410.rule: Inline the imported props alias as an inline object type in the component module.

E7409.msg: CommonJS require not supported in project mode
E7409.rule: Remove the require; if it feeds render, inline a literal, else drop the dependent code.

E7401.msg: Unable to read source for graph scan

_pre_conversion_reject.note: Repo-level filters that fire before any file is converted; not part of the LLM pass. Counted for reference over 100 candidates.
